s.how: Double-fried shoestring fries smothered in beef chilli and melted cheddar sauce, topped with diced onion and pickled jalapeños, in red-checked paper boats. Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and soak 1 hour, then dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, drain, then at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp and salt them. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 onion, add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder and 200g tomato passata and simmer 15 minutes. Warm 200ml evaporated milk and melt in 150g grated cheddar. Pile fries into paper boats with chilli, cheese sauce, diced onion and jalapeños.

s.note: Popcorn baked in butter and brown sugar toffee with roasted peanuts
s.how: Pop 120g kernels in 2 tbsp coconut oil in a covered pot, shaking, and tip into a large bowl. Melt 100g butter with 150g brown sugar and 3 tbsp golden syrup, boil 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb soda and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn with 100g roasted peanuts and toss well. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break up.

m.note: Two smashed beef patties with American cheese, onion, pickles and mustard
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g beef mince on a smoking griddle, salt and flip at 90 seconds, adding American cheese. Stack two per soft toasted bun with diced onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream with strawberry sauce and chocolate fudge, cream and a cherry
w.how: Blitz 250g strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses and spoon over both sauces. Top with whipped cream and a cherry.

d.note: Cola over vanilla ice cream and cherry syrup
d.how: Spoon 1 tbsp cherry syrup into each of 4 tall glasses and add a big scoop of vanilla ice cream. Pour 250ml cold cola slowly down the side so it foams up, top with a maraschino cherry and serve with a long spoon and a straw.
